name: Taiflex Scientific Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiflex Scientific Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture, wholesale, and retail of electronic parts and components in Taiwan, Mainland China, and internationally. The company offers flexible copper-clad laminate and cover layer; generation and selling of electricity from renewables; and FPC materials such as FCCL, coverlay, bonding sheet, and composited materials for battery, industrial control, automotive applications, comprehensive product specifications, FPC circuit protection, and components.
